GLS.feature.stream-targets.title: Targeting Lines
GLS.feature.stream-targets.hint: During combat, a line runs from the combatant whose turn it is to each token it targets and locks on with four corner brackets. Colours follow disposition, and each client only draws lines between tokens it can see. The editor can widen that to every token at once, and to outside combat.

GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.targeting.hint: A line runs from the combatant whose turn it is to every token it targets. Each client only draws lines between tokens it can see, and secret dispositions count as neutral. Players can hide lines on their own screen from the Control Center. Away from the current turn, under either option above, only player-controlled tokens draw: Foundry records targets per user, so a GM's single selection belongs to no particular NPC.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.targeting.hintNoStream: Turn on the Stream Client feature to choose who sees the lines.
